data.output:
{
  "jobspec": "#!/bin/bash
#flux: --job-name=bead-select
#flux: -N 1
#flux: -n 1
#flux: --time-limit=100h

# Note: PBS -l mem directive (7GB) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Memory limits not enforced. Job may be killed if exceeding node memory.
# Note: PBS -q directive (WitsLong) does not have a direct Flux equivalent.
# Performance consideration: Queue selection not preserved. Job may run on different queue/priority.
# Note: PBS array functionality (-t 0-1024 and PBS_ARRAYID) does not have a direct Flux batch equivalent.
# You may need to submit multiple jobs or use flux bulksubmit for array-like behavior.
# Performance consideration: Array task functionality not available. Script will fail without manual adjustment.

hostname

cd  /spaces/scott/chip/pool_selection/

# WARNING: PBS_ARRAYID is not available in Flux.
# You need to replace this with a specific value or use flux bulksubmit.
# For array job conversion, consider using: flux bulksubmit --wait-event=start ...
run=${PBS_ARRAYID}
/usr/bin/time  python pool_select.py --input all.cpickle --label S${LABEL} --bad badscore60.lst --requests extra.lst,req_func_u.scores --factor 1.5 $run 10 18
"
}
